clue.text: Partner follows belly to local stout

explanation.walkthrough: 'Stout' looks like the beer at the local, but it is the adjective meaning plump. 'belly to' takes the central C of LOCAL; 'follows' puts HUBBY after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone plump or well rounded in body.

clue.text: Rejected players abroad

clue.text: Under serving area is clean jumble, which can be sticky
